SELECT A.CO_CODE,A.LC_CODE,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.AC_CODE,A.AC_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.DHRN_AMT,SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT) As DhrnRec,(A.DHRN_AMT - SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT)) As PanDhrn,A.INT_PRC,E.AC_MOBILE, (SELECT TOP 1 C.TO_DATE FROM DHRN_DATA AS C WHERE C.CO_CODE = A.CO_CODE AND C.LC_CODE = A.LC_CODE AND C.ISU_YRCD = A.CO_YEAR AND C.ISU_DBCD = A.CO_BOOK AND C.ISU_NO = A.VCH_NO ORDER BY C.TO_DATE DESC) As FromDt, DATEDIFF(DAY,(SELECT TOP 1 D.TO_DATE FROM DHRN_DATA AS D WHERE D.CO_CODE = A.CO_CODE AND D.LC_CODE = A.LC_CODE AND D.ISU_YRCD = A.CO_YEAR AND D.ISU_DBCD = A.CO_BOOK AND D.ISU_NO = A.VCH_NO ORDER BY D.TO_DATE DESC),' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ') AS IntDays,A.DHRN_DUE_DATE FROM ((DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN DHRN_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ISU_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ISU_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ISU_NO)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = E.AC_CODE) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS F ON A.CO_CODE = F.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = F.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = F.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.DHRN_DUE_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.DHRN_DUE_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.DHRN_DUE_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY A.CO_CODE,A.LC_CODE,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.AC_CODE,A.AC_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.DHRN_AMT,A.INT_PRC,E.AC_MOBILE,A.DHRN_DUE_DATE ORDER BY A.AC_NAME,A.DHRN_DUE_DATE
